fit_note: Phone harness routing tasks across device CLI, MCP host tools and delegated GUI subtasks in one loop.
Desktop-grounded task proposal with binary precondition judge, verdict-conditioned retry and rare-app coverage synthesis.
Induced web skills stored with structural page sketches, retrieved by layout similarity and slot-bound on live pages.
Compiles successful runs into predicate-checked state-machine programs replayed without LLM calls, gated by re-run verification.
On-policy self-distillation for grounding with box-compatibility gating and teacher-probability weighting; no rule reward GRPO.
Per-application multimodal skill files built from manuals and live UI exploration, loaded on demand through an MCP tool.
Recovery data from policy-induced off-trajectory states: skill-guided continuations after k own steps, SFT mixed with experts.
Policy emits memory add/update/delete and history-folding actions alongside UI actions to retain cross-app facts.
VLM critic gives outcome, step-level labels and corrective hints that select steps for hint-conditioned step-level GRPO.
Mines SKILL.md-style skills by segmenting and clustering logged trajectories, then GRPO on skill composition; not agent's own runs.
